meaning:
1) to dig, row
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to dig (into houses-of burglary)
1a2) to row (in water)

elsewhere.note: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
